_README: Template for a new migration run. Copy to plans/<PROJECT>.plan.json and replace every __PLACEHOLDER__. Then: bash orchestration/run.sh plans/<PROJECT>.plan.json. Placeholders: __PROJECT__ (folder under projects/, e.g. acme), __SITE_URL__ (reference URL), __NAMESPACE__ (CND namespace, e.g. acme), __MIX_NAMESPACE__ (e.g. acmemix), __SITE_KEY__ (Jahia siteKey), __LANG__ (primary language, e.g. en), __PAGES__ (comma-separated page slugs, home first), __REPO_ABS_PATH__ (absolute path to jahiaMigration). Prereq: projects/__PROJECT__/.env must define JAHIA_USER, JAHIA_HOST, and JAHIA_MCP_TOKEN (gitignored). The structure mirrors plans/sial-paris.plan.json; keep the PROBE: lines verbatim.
goal: Migrate __SITE_URL__ to a Jahia JS module (project: __PROJECT__, namespace __NAMESPACE__, siteKey __SITE_KEY__, language __LANG__). Each step is proven by its PROBE command; a step is done only when the probe exits 0.

epics.title: Foundation: connect + analyze
epics.goal: Confirm Jahia reachable and produce a complete component/content manifest.

stories.title: Analyze the reference site
stories.description: Verify connectivity, then analyze __SITE_URL__ into a manifest and content data.

steps.title: Verify Jahia connection (Gate 0)
acceptance_criteria: PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/connect.sh projects/__PROJECT__

steps.title: Crawl & inventory all pages + assets
acceptance_criteria: Run: python3 orchestration/lib/crawl-site.py projects/__PROJECT__ __SITE_URL__ --max-pages __MAX_PAGES__ --depth __DEPTH__
Downloads HTML pages AND referenced assets (CSS, JS, images, fonts) into .reference/cache/.
Rewrites HTML to reference local asset paths (no live CDN calls during later steps).
For JS/WAF sites that block the crawler, capture remaining pages via browser (capture-reference skill).
Write workflow-output/page-inventory.json with URL, slug, title, httpStatus, cachedAt, contentLength for every page.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/crawl.sh projects/__PROJECT__

steps.title: Extract HTML blocks (deterministic, agnostic)
acceptance_criteria: Run: python3 orchestration/lib/extract-blocks.py projects/__PROJECT__
Extracts ALL structural blocks from every crawled HTML page — purely deterministic, no decisions.
Each block has: tag, classes, depth, parentTag, childTags, textContent, hasImage, hasLink, hasHeading, imageUrls, linkUrls, headingTexts.
Write workflow-output/html-blocks.json.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/extract-blocks.sh projects/__PROJECT__

steps.title: Group pages by shared template (LLM analysis)
acceptance_criteria: Read workflow-output/html-blocks.json — the extracted blocks are your source of truth.
Analyze the STRUCTURAL SKELETON of each page (header, footer, nav, main content regions) to identify shared templates.
Do NOT use hardcoded CSS class patterns. Use semantic analysis: what blocks are in <header>? in <footer>? in <main>? What's the content structure?
Identify cross-cutting regions (header, footer, nav) that appear on ALL pages.
Write workflow-output/template-clusters.json with clusters, crossCutting, unclustered.
Every page from page-inventory.json must belong to exactly 1 cluster OR crossCutting.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/template-cluster.sh projects/__PROJECT__

steps.title: Discover reusable components (LLM analysis)
acceptance_criteria: Read workflow-output/html-blocks.json — the extracted blocks are your source of truth.
Cluster blocks by DATA SHAPE (same fields = same type, even if CSS/markup differs).
Do NOT use hardcoded component name patterns. Analyze the actual content: what fields does each block have? What's its role?
Identify cross-cutting components (nav, footer, topbar) — blocks that appear on ALL pages with the same structure.
Identify jmix:mainResource components — blocks that represent content with its own navigable URL (news articles, events, products).
Write workflow-output/component-candidates.json with frequency, dataShape, isCrossCutting, isMainResource.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/component-discover.sh projects/__PROJECT__

steps.title: Model CND types + views (Gate 1: HALT)
acceptance_criteria: Use the namespace from inputs (__NAMESPACE__ / __MIX_NAMESPACE__) for EVERY nodeType — do NOT invent a different prefix.
Map each candidate to a CND type with fields, views, areaType. jmix:mainResource MUST have default + fullPage views.
No two types may share the same property shape (dup-shapes.sh). Prefer views over new types.
SXA: account for every extracted component (sxaSource or sxaIgnored).
Write workflow-output/component-manifest.json.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/component-model.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __NAMESPACE__
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/sxa-coverage.sh projects/__PROJECT__
Gate 1: present manifest + field splits, return status halt.

steps.title: Extract canonical HTML fragments
acceptance_criteria: For each component/view in component-manifest.json, extract the verbatim HTML from the cached pages.
Write workflow-output/html-fragments/<ComponentName>.<viewName>.html — one file per component/view.
Fragments must contain real CSS classes (not simplified). Replace only dynamic text with {placeholders}.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/html-fragments.sh projects/__PROJECT__

steps.title: Extract content data (deterministic)
acceptance_criteria: Run deterministic extractors: source_detect.py + extract_content.py from orchestration/lib/.
Write workflow-output/content-data.json with REAL field values per component instance (not placeholders).
Home page must have instances with real text. Total extracted text > 500 chars.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/content-extract.sh projects/__PROJECT__

steps.title: Catalogue all source images
acceptance_criteria: Run extract_media.py from orchestration/lib/.
Write workflow-output/asset-inventory.json with every image per page.
Home page must have at least 1 image.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/asset-inventory.sh projects/__PROJECT__

steps.title: Implement components
acceptance_criteria: Implement components ONE at a time — never batch-stub them all then build at the end. The build-time gate here is components-all.sh: it validates source-pairing + no-stub + en/fr i18n for EVERY component and builds once. NOTE: component-validate.sh additionally DEPLOYS and RENDERS a non-home page, so it only passes AFTER content/pages exist — it is a POST-CONTENT per-component debugging gate (used while iterating on a single deployed component), NOT run at this step.

Per-component completeness gate over EVERY component (loops each, FAILS naming any stubbed / unlabelled / viewless component, builds the module once): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/components-all.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __NAMESPACE__
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/css-hooks.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __NS__
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/contract.sh projects/__PROJECT__ step_components

steps.title: Layout + templates
acceptance_criteria: PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/templates.sh projects/__PROJECT__
2-3 page templates by ROLE (home/section/detail); restrict each Area with allowedNodeTypes (.agents/skills/08-page-templates): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/template-govern.sh projects/__PROJECT__
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/contract.sh projects/__PROJECT__ step_templates

steps.title: Deploy (Gate 3: HALT)
acceptance_criteria: PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/deploy.sh projects/__PROJECT__
Render-gate the deployed shell (header/nav/footer must not be collapsed/broken): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/render-all.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __SITE_KEY__ __LANG__ /home
Gate 3: present deployed shell screenshot, return status halt.

epics.title: Content + review + accessibility
epics.goal: Create + publish all content, review, accessibility audit.

stories.title: Create + publish content
stories.description: Create and publish all pages (__PAGES__) to live.

steps.title: Import media into the DAM (deterministic)
acceptance_criteria: Import EVERY image from the deterministic manifest (orchestration/images/<project>.json) into the DAM via orchestration/images/import.py — do not skip media. This is the 0-of-40-images fix.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/media.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __SITE__
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/contract.sh projects/__PROJECT__ step_media

steps.title: Create content (Gate 4: HALT)
acceptance_criteria: LOAD content from orchestration/content/<project>.content-load.json and wire imported media from orchestration/images/<project>.imported.json — do NOT improvise text or invent placeholder content (the captured source is the source of truth).

Run the DETERMINISTIC MCP loader to create content from the extracted source: python3 orchestration/lib/load_content.py __PROJECT__ __SITE__ --clean  — it creates each node via MCP content.create with real field values AND wires the imported image weakref at create time (lib/mcp_client.py), then publishes. Do NOT hand-write GraphQL or improvise content.

Use the Jahia MCP server (JSON-RPC at $JAHIA_HOST/modules/mcp) for ALL node creation, property edits, and publishing. GraphQL is a fallback only when the MCP cannot do it; state any fallback in the summary.

IMAGES = DAM weakreferences, NEVER url strings (AGENTS.md 2a). Import via MCP media.upload.url (consistent UUID), set the WEAKREFERENCE field (image/backgroundImage/logo/photo), clear any *ExternalUrl string. Canonical tools: orchestration/images/set_hero_refs.py and set_image_refs.py __PROJECT__ __SITE_KEY__ __NAMESPACE__. Capture source URLs via browser (site blocks the agent).
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/mcp.sh projects/__PROJECT__
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/content.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __SITE_KEY__ __LANG__ __PAGES__
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/no-url-images.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __SITE_KEY__ __NAMESPACE__

Render-gate EACH page as you finish it (do not defer to the end). The step is not done until every page renders clean: PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/render-all.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __SITE_KEY__ __LANG__ __PAGES__

Publish completeness: every weakref'd asset (image/logo/link/category) must resolve in LIVE and every translation must be published (publish WITH languages:[__LANG__]): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/publish-parity.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __SITE_KEY__ __LANG__

Editability: shared regions (nav/footer/topbar) must render AND be editable in Page Builder, not blank (AbsoluteAreas need child content nodes): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/edit-frame.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __SITE_KEY__ __LANG__ home

Quality: every page passes a11y (axe-core, no critical/serious) + SEO baseline (title, meta, single h1, img alt): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/site-review.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __SITE_KEY__ __LANG__ __PAGES__

Reuse guard: content/page discovery must NOT add types beyond the approved per-project baseline (reuse a type or add a view instead): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/no-new-types.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __NAMESPACE__ projects/__PROJECT__/component-baseline.txt
Gate 4: present reference vs Jahia screenshots, return status halt.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/no-graphql-writes.sh projects/__PROJECT__
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/contract.sh projects/__PROJECT__ step_content

steps.title: Code review (Gate 5: HALT)

APPROVE only if every gate is green and no critical/major finding stands.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/artifact.sh projects/__PROJECT__/workflow-output/review/REVIEW.md
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/no-stub.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __NAMESPACE__
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/cnd-review.sh projects/__PROJECT__
Reuse/views: no two types may share a property shape (consolidate into one type + views): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/dup-shapes.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __NAMESPACE__

Reuse guard against the FROZEN baseline (do NOT re-write it here — it was frozen at step_content_types): PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/no-new-types.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __NAMESPACE__ projects/__PROJECT__/component-baseline.txt
Gate 5: present findings, return status halt.
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/css-hooks.sh projects/__PROJECT__ __NS__
PROBE: bash orchestration/probes/contract.sh projects/__PROJECT__ step_review
